mcp_tools.name: grpc_service_design
mcp_tools.title: Grpc service design
mcp_tools.description: Submits a gRPC service design record (contract and compatibility, API shape and deadlines, server hygiene, security and transport, observability, testing and interop) and returns a deterministic GRPC_SERVICE_SOUND / GRPC_SERVICE_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across five sections, including computed method deadline and streaming-boundedness and proto field-number checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared design record; it serves no RPCs.

inputSchema.description: The gRPC service design manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

expect.notes: All 39 checks pass. Computed: methods_count=1, proto_fields_count=2, deadline_coverage=1.000000, streaming_boundedness_coverage=null (no streaming methods), computed_status=within_stated_limits_on_declared_evidence.
